transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… I guess I’m here because my eating’s been kind of out of hand lately. Like after a long shift, or after studying, I’ll end up eating way more than I meant to—fast food, snacks, whatever’s in the fridge—all in one sitting.
Do you usually feel guilty after these episodes of eating more than you meant to?
I mean… yeah, sometimes. I don’t really like thinking about it, but afterward I usually don’t feel great about it.
How often do these episodes of eating more than you meant to happen?
Most weeks, I guess… there’s at least one night where it happens. And then I’ll try to make up for it somehow. It’s been like that for a few months.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after one of these eating episodes?
Yeah… sometimes. I don’t really like saying it, but I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up after. Sometimes I’ve used laxatives too, if I’m worried about what I ate.
How often do you make yourself vomit after one of these eating episodes?
Not every time… but sometimes after I eat too much, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. Other times I’ve taken laxatives, if I’m really scared about what the food’s gonna do.
Have you noticed any big changes in your weight over the past few months?
I don’t know… not really big changes, I don’t think. I don’t weigh myself all the time, so I’m not totally sure.
How often do you make yourself vomit after eating?
I mean… not every time. Just sometimes, when I feel like I ate too much. I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up.
How often do you use laxatives after eating?
Sometimes. Not every time I eat or anything… just when I feel like I really messed up, I’ll take them because I get scared about what the food’s going to do.
How many times a week do you have these episodes of eating more than you meant to?
Most weeks… maybe at least one night, I guess. Where I eat more than I meant to. It’s been like that for a few months.
How many times a week do you make yourself vomit after eating?
Usually maybe once a week… sometimes more if I feel like I really overdid it. I don’t like talking about it, but yeah, I’ll go make myself throw up sometimes.
How often do you use laxatives after eating?
Like I said, it’s not every time. Just sometimes after I feel like I ate too much… I’ll take them because I get worried about what the food’s gonna do.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short time without later making yourself vomit or using laxatives?
Yeah… that happens too. Like after a long shift, or if I’ve been studying, I’ll just kind of eat a lot at once — fast food, snacks, whatever’s in the fridge. I don’t always… do anything after.
How many times a week do you eat a large amount of food in a short time without later making yourself vomit or using laxatives?

Maybe… a couple times a week. Usually after a long shift or studying, I’ll just eat way more than I meant to — like fast food and snacks and whatever’s around — and then I don’t always do anything after.
Do you usually make yourself vomit or use laxatives after most of your binge eating episodes?

Most of them? I don’t know… not every time. But yeah, sometimes when I feel like I ate too much, I’ll go make myself throw up, or I’ll take laxatives. I just get scared about what the food’s gonna do.
How many times a week do you eat a large amount of food in a short time without doing anything to try to undo the effects of the eating?
Probably a couple times a week… usually after work or studying. I’ll just eat a lot in one sitting, like fast food and snacks, and then I don’t really do anything after.
How many times a week do you eat a large amount of food in a short time without making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or doing anything else to try to undo the effects of the eating?
Yeah… probably a couple times a week. It’s usually after a long shift or studying, and I’ll eat a lot all at once — fast food, snacks, whatever’s in the fridge — and then I just kind of leave it.
How many times a week do you eat a large amount of food in a short time?
A few times a week, I guess. Usually after a long shift or when I’m done studying… I’ll end up eating way more than I meant to, all in one sitting.
How many times a week do you eat a large amount of food in a short time without doing anything to try to undo the effects of the eating?
Yeah… like I said, a few times a week. After work or studying, I’ll end up eating way too much in one sitting — fast food, snacks, stuff from the fridge — and then I don’t really do anything after.
How many times a week do you eat a large amount of food in a short time without making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or doing anything else to try to undo the effects of the eating?

Yeah… I mean, that’s kind of what’s been happening. After a long shift or studying, I’ll eat way more than I meant to — like fast food, snacks, whatever’s around — all at once. Usually it’s a few times a week.
How many times a week do you eat a large amount of food in a short time without doing anything to try to undo the effects of the eating?
I guess it’s still a few times a week. Like after a long shift or studying, I’ll just eat a lot at once… fast food, snacks, whatever’s in the fridge. Then I don’t really do anything after.
